testcases.TestCaseName: Splash Screen routes brand-new user to Onboarding Screen S1.1 on cold launch
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Fresh install with no session and no saved preferences: cold launch shows Splash, then routes to Onboarding S1.1 (not Recurring Login, not Dashboard).
testcases.AppState: Fresh install — no session, no saved preferences
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Splash appears on cold launch; routing completes; user lands on Onboarding S1.1 — not Recurring Login, not Dashboard
testcases.AssertionsSummary: Splash Screen appears on cold launch; routing evaluation completes without error; destination is Onboarding S1.1; no crash or blank screen

testcases.TestCaseName: Splash Screen routes a returning user (no active session but saved preferences exist) to Recurring Login Screen 7 on cold launch
testcases.TestCaseDescription: No active session but saved preferences exist: cold launch shows Splash, then routes to Recurring Login / Last Login Screen 7 (not Onboarding, not Dashboard).
testcases.AppState: No active session; saved preferences present from prior login with Remember Me checked
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Splash appears; destination is Recurring Login Screen 7 — not Onboarding, not Dashboard; Screen 7 shows tenant logo, title, saved account card, biometric CTA (platform-specific), and 'Other Sign In Options' CTA
testcases.AssertionsSummary: Destination is Recurring Login Screen 7; onboarding not shown; dashboard not shown; core Screen 7 UI elements displayed
